label: 50k
boundary: Real Chrome 156 extension (CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked path), real storage/bookmarks/sidePanel/tabs APIs, 50k native bookmarks from profile Bookmarks file.
Test-only changes in loaded copy: bookmarks permission required (no prompt automation); native-harness.html/js for a trusted click that calls sidePanel.open.
Alt+O accelerator is not pressed (CDP cannot); quick switcher uses the same QUICK_SWITCHER_SHOW message from the real content-script world.
Page targets are paused at creation for tens of ms (hookup: 31 ms) to install a passive recorder; pauseMs is recorded per row and precedes navigation start. Workers are never debugger-attached.
laterOnOnboardingSeen=true is set in the owned test profile so the first-run guide does not cover timed UI; rows with a guide overlay are counted in overlayRows.
Web hosts resolve to NOTFOUND (no network); tab reuse targets are error pages with the original URL.
